base.rule: the dataset's partitions; dev even / odd = calibration / report; train_order = train permuted by np.random.default_rng(0)

heldout_templates.rule: templates with >= 3 items over all partitions, held out when h01(0, 'template', template) < 0.15

ood_intents.rule: the 1 intents with >= 50 training items and the lowest h01(0, 'ood', intent) leave train and dev_cal (every item in which they occur at any level)
